messages:
lina: quick heads-up - saw a CI onboarding fail. sampleapp picked the wrong project when both REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT and an org-scoped key are present.

samir: which project did it choose?

lina: it used `redwood-prod` from the env even though the key is `org:acme:abcd` and should map to `acme-prod`.

maria: do you have repro steps?

lina: yes: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=org_acme_abcd
export REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT=redwood-prod
node sampleapp/start.js`
app ends up using REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT.

samir: that violates precedence. our intended order is: explicit param > key-bound project > REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT > interactive.

ajay: CLI is inconsistent (env var > key-bound). we should align.

lina: root cause: introspect fallback ordering. node sdk currently: `let project = process.env.REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT || await introspectKey(apiKey).project;` so env var wins if introspect is slow or fails.

maria: fix should invert order and add logging/telemetry when fallback occurs. also add test for introspect failure path.

ajay: also add a soft AuthScopeMismatch error for rotation cases so runs don't silently switch projects.

devx-bot: PR #4583 opened by lina - "fix(auth): prefer key-bound project over REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT". CI queued.

lina: will add sampleapp README note about env var ambiguity and update SDK docs.

samir: after PR we should ship a patch and add a changelog entry so operators know about the precedence behavior.

devx-bot: CI passed for #4583 :tada:

lina: merged into 0.9.3. follow-up: add CLI parity change + integration test in next minor.
